   - The condition to free `map->debugfs_name` when the name is "dummy" was corrected to ensure it only frees the memory if `map->debugfs_name` is not NULL.
   - Additional checks were added after memory allocations to handle potential allocation failures.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `regmap-debugfs.c` are directly related to fixing a memory leak issue that arises when `regmap_attach_dev` is called after initializing the regmap. By ensuring that `map->debugfs_name` is only allocated when it is NULL and properly freed when necessary, the patch addresses the memory leak that was identified in the bug report. This change enhances the stability and memory management of the regmap functionality, particularly in scenarios where the debugfs name is reused or not needed.
